DEFINE
  VAR __Window = FILTER('Metrics By Item Operation And Day', 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Timepoint] >= @Start && 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Timepoint] < @End)
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
  'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Id],
  'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Name],
  'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[SKU],
  'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Units],
  'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Region],

  "__ObservedAt", MAX('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Timepoint]),

  "__PeakUtilizationPercent", MAX('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Interactive Billable %]),
  "__WorkspaceCount", DISTINCTCOUNT('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Workspace Id]),

  "__BackgroundRejectionPercent", MAX('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Background Rejection %]),

)

generations.name: metricsDailyWithDimensions
generations.table: Metrics By Item Operation And Day

queries.capacitySummary:
DEFINE
  VAR __Window = FILTER(
    'Metrics By Item Operation And Day',
    'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Datetime] >= @Start &&
    'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Datetime] < @End
  )
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS(
  SUMMARIZE('Capacities', 'Capacities'[Capacity Id], 'Capacities'[Capacity name],
    'Capacities'[SKU], 'Capacities'[Region], 'Capacities'[State]),
  "CapacityId", 'Capacities'[Capacity Id],
  "CapacityName", 'Capacities'[Capacity name],
  "Sku", 'Capacities'[SKU],
  "Region", 'Capacities'[Region],
  "CapacityState", 'Capacities'[State],
  "TotalCuSeconds", VAR __Capacity = 'Capacities'[Capacity Id]
    RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[CU (s)]), __Window, 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Id] = __Capacity),
  "ObservedAt", VAR __Capacity = 'Capacities'[Capacity Id]
    RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Datetime]), __Window, 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Id] = __Capacity),
  "WorkspaceCount", VAR __Capacity = 'Capacities'[Capacity Id]
    RETURN CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Workspace Id]), __Window, 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Id] = __Capacity),
  "ItemCount", VAR __Capacity = 'Capacities'[Capacity Id]
    RETURN CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Item Id]), __Window, 'Metrics By Item Operation And Day'[Capacity Id] = __Capacity),
  "WindowStart", FORMAT(CEILING(@Start, 1), "yyyy-mm-dd", "en-US") & "T00:00:00Z",
  "WindowEnd", FORMAT(@End, "yyyy-mm-dd", "en-US") & "T" & FORMAT(@End, "hh:nn:ss", "en-US") & "Z",
  "StorageBytes", BLANK(),
  "MeanUtilizationPercent", BLANK(),
  "PeakUtilizationPercent", BLANK()
)
ORDER BY [CapacityId]
